scene.ui:title: Scene
scene.ui:description: The Scene name as configured in Composer

layer.ui:title: Layer
layer.ui:description: The Layer name within that Scene

functionName.ui:title: Function Name
functionName.ui:description: The Script Engine function name to execute

switcherId.ui:title: Switcher ID
switcherId.ui:description: The GUID of the Composer switcher object. Mutually exclusive with Switcher Name.

switcherName.ui:title: Switcher Name
switcherName.ui:description: The name of the Composer switcher object. Mutually exclusive with Switcher ID.

mediaPlayerId.ui:title: Media Player ID
mediaPlayerId.ui:description: The GUID of the Video File Input. Both Media Player ID and Media Player Name are required — the GUID is used for property/command calls while the name is needed for the atomic load-and-play endpoint.

mediaPlayerName.ui:title: Media Player Name
mediaPlayerName.ui:description: The name of the Video File Input as configured in Composer. Required alongside Media Player ID — see its description.

autoPlayOnMediaChange.ui:title: Auto Play On Media Change
autoPlayOnMediaChange.ui:description: Sets the AutoPlayOnMediaChange property on the device. When true, the player automatically begins playing when the source changes.

webPageRendererId.ui:title: Web Page Renderer ID
webPageRendererId.ui:description: The GUID of the Web Page Renderer object in Composer. Mutually exclusive with Web Page Renderer Name.

webPageRendererName.ui:title: Web Page Renderer Name
webPageRendererName.ui:description: The name of the Web Page Renderer object as configured in Composer. Mutually exclusive with Web Page Renderer ID.

audioSourceId.ui:title: Audio Source ID
audioSourceId.ui:description: The GUID of the audio source object in Composer. Mutually exclusive with Audio Source Name.

audioSourceName.ui:title: Audio Source Name
audioSourceName.ui:description: The name of the audio source object as configured in Composer. Mutually exclusive with Audio Source ID.
